method: Original-speed audio; video speed adjusted to corresponding segment duration. Approximate segment alignment, not word or lip alignment. Source gaps absent from benchmark are skipped.
versionAlignment: Second-take boundaries independently located with 10-second ASR windows plus language-specific boundary checks; approximate, not human-audited word timing.

sentenceSync.method: Per-utterance timing with original OCR/ASR and model word/phrase onsets. Preserve original-speed audio. Hold video during pauses; jump over source gaps. Approximate boundaries, not lip sync.
sentenceSync.limits: MiniMax take 1 prolonged anomalous portion is retained within the corresponding long sentence and held at its final reference frame.

fiveRoleAlignment: New audio timings use the native AAF timeline (41 speech blocks); original-video sentence anchors remain approximate. Five roles and emotion tags differ from the original single-voice test.
